title: Exact Python and PostgreSQL Unicode folding pair
question: Do the exact selected Python/UCD and PostgreSQL builtin collation agree on Unicode default folding over the supported PostgreSQL text domain?
method: Read-only comparison of every supported scalar mapping, plus six independently specified sequence cases and a changed-determinant refusal at the Python admission boundary. No normalization is applied.

outputs.role: exact runtime pair, full mapping digest and independent cases

conclusion: The exact CPython3.14.10/UCD16.0.0 and PostgreSQL18.6/UTF8/builtin pg_unicode_fast version1 pair agrees on every scalar mapping within PostgreSQL's text domain, excluding NUL and surrogates. Composed and decomposed strings remain distinct. Other runtime pairs are unqualified; native deployment binding and integrated publication require their own evidence.
